source_order: Talbot and Ogden 2008 section 2.3: available surface water funds existing-front advance demand in bin order; when an unsaturated-at-surface bin is reached, a dry-bin front Z_d is created and its corresponding storage volume is debited; continue until water exhausted or last bin

frozen_scope.existing_front: one real-MvG B2D-R1 front using grouped Eq18 and conservative Heun RK2
frozen_scope.dry_front_depth_Zd: immutable supplied fixture, not Green-Ampt-qualified here

generic_creation_primitive.delta_theta: explicit argument taken from the same real FWC discretization as the existing front
generic_creation_primitive.parity_requirement: must reproduce B2E-A creation/debit behavior when called with B2E-A fixture delta_theta

hard_guards: Do not qualify Green-Ampt Z_d calculation.
Do not infer partially funded dry fronts.
Do not change Eq18 or Heun physics/policy from B2D-R1.
Do not use different delta-theta widths for existing and newly created fronts in the composed physical cases.
No redistribution, groundwater, crop, runtime or MultiSWAP production qualification.
